hook.name: DarkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the $DARK token that applies a 1% buy-side tax: when DARK is the output token of a swap, 1% is taken via afterSwap and forwarded to a CrystalForge contract for distribution to Crystal NFT holders pro-rata by bonded power. Sells are tax-free. The forge address is set once by the deployer and then permanently frozen.
